name: 12093-longprefill-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), driver 570.195.03.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, one in-process engine on one GPU.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, bf16, 8B dense; 32 layers, hidden 4096, 32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, vocab 128256, max_position_embeddings 131072.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 1000 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: single-turn synthetic text, no shared prefix; prompt exactly 2048 tokens and output exactly 128, min=max on both, temperature 0.0 and ignore_eos, prefix caching off.
purpose: A document summarization service on one GPU, using an 8B model for 64 concurrent two-thousand-token requests with short summaries.
launch:
# The engine's command line. One dense 8B engine on one H100.
#
# vLLM 0.6.6-era AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction.
# Do not add a key from a later vLLM.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096
max-num-batched-tokens: 16384
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: false
